hooks.name: aidlc-sync-statusline
hooks.description: Syncs aidlc-state.md Current Stage from the audit tail after shell commands. DELIBERATELY matched to execute_bash, not a task/spec tool: the IDE surfaces no task payload a sync could parse, so the hook derives the stage from the audit tail (do not 'optimize' this to a task matcher). Cost: the audit tail is read on every execute_bash; the hook self-gates idempotently so re-reads are correctness-safe, and the read is bounded by audit size.
